description: GitHub hosts Git projects and tools for working together. Learn repository pages, issues, pull requests and checks through written examples that need no account. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain find your way around a repository
Explain write an issue someone can reproduce
Explain use the files changed view
learningObjectives: Practise protect the main branch with rules
Practise fork a project or clone it

seo.title: GitHub Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn GitHub with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
